draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 64th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 10th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 100, well after his grade rank (64th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tyrann Mathieu. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (4th percentile). College production: 1 passes defended in 2020, 29th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 60 career games and 40 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Weak spots: passes defended 1 (20th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 53.0% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
